title: Effective valorisation of cereal lignocellulosic waste: a review of pretreatment techniques to enhance microstructural modification
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,241-260
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00624D, Review Article
Open Access

Smriti Ale, Pramesh Dhungana, Janet Howieson, Rewati Raman Bhattarai
Pretreatment of lignocellulosic biomass, such as cereal husks, disrupts structural bonds to improve enzyme accessibility and hydrolysis, supporting sustainable waste valorisation into fermentable sugars and value-added applications.
